title: Extension properties of planar subsets supporting a weak $(1,1)$-Poincaré inequality
summary: We study Sobolev and $BV$-extension properties of planar subsets. In particular, we prove that fat Sierpiński carpets that support a weak $(1,1)$-Poincaré inequality are $W^{1,1}$-extension sets, and we provide an explicit linear extension operator for them. We also show that for planar domains satisfying a weak $(1,1)$-Poincaré inequality the $W^{1,1}$-extension property and the $BV$-extension property are equivalent.
